newsitem.title: USA: Spot US propane prices up cold weather concerns.
newsitem.headline: Spot US propane prices up cold weather concerns.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices were stronger in thin late trade Thursday amid short covering and reports of a cold weather snap heading for the Midwest, players said.
Forecasters said Thursday a winter storm will likely blanket the southern and central U.S. Plains with snow early next week, followed by frigid temperatures.
On the cold weather news, Conway, Kansas, spot propane jumped another 1 cent in midday trade to between 84.75 cents and 85.00 cents a gallon.
The market opened at 79.50 cents this morning.
Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot material in the U.S. Gulf Coast, rose a slight quarter cent to 56.50/57.25 cents.

Players said there was some short covering in both hubs as many traders tried to get barrels ahead of an industry-wide holiday party Thursday evening, which is expected to keep many offices empty Friday.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1631
